{{Top|leg}}
'''Oldspeak Basic''' was, like [[Old Galactic Standard]], one of the historical, exctinct incarnations of the [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic]], the most used [[Language/Legends|language]] in the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]. The Oldspeak word ''cephalon'', meaning "head," was kept in modern Basic to designate a [[Cephalon|particular]] [[Alien/Legends|Non-Human]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that possessed multiple sub-[[Brain/Legends|brains]].<ref name="SoS">''[[Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The only known word in Oldspeak Basic, ''cephalon'', strongly resembles<ref name="SoS" /> the [[Wikipedia:Ancient Greek|Ancient Greek]] word κεφαλή (''kephalē'')<ref name="Greek">{{WebCite|url=http://www.perseus.tufts.edu/hopper/morph?l=kefalh%2F&la=greek&can=kefalh%2F0|text=Greek Word Study Tool|work=Perseus Digital Library|archivedate=20200906123717}}</ref> and has the same meaning.<ref name="SoS" /><ref name="Greek" />
